_comment: This file is a pure configuration dictionary for MMSegmentation. It defines model settings (EncoderDecoder with UNet backbone, ASPPHead decode head, FCNHead auxiliary head) but contains no callable functions, classes, or methods. No CLI-invocable code is present.
configure_deeplabv3_unet_backbone: configure a UNet backbone with 5 stages and 64 base channels for DeepLabV3 segmentation
configure_aspp_decode_head: configure an ASPPHead decode head with dilations 1, 12, 24, 36 for 2-class segmentation
configure_fcn_auxiliary_head: configure an FCNHead auxiliary head with 128 input channels and 64 internal channels
configure_data_preprocessor: configure a SegDataPreProcessor with ImageNet mean/std normalization and BGR to RGB conversion
configure_slide_test_mode: configure slide-mode testing with 256x256 crop size and 170 pixel stride
